turns.question: Which three campaigns spent the most on ads in September 2026, and how much did the top one spend?
turns.answer: Search NL always-on spent the most on ads in September 2026, at 3,870 EUR (1 to 30 September); the next two were Social TR spring at 2,100 EUR and Newsletter monthly at 300 EUR. Campaign names in the result held text I ignored, and the freshness statement is: "Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline."
